question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

We agree that Professor Revanth is very knowledgeable, but we do not like attending his classes because he always keeps __blowing the trumpet__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (blowing his own trumpet)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"blowing the trumpet"** is not correct in this context, as it does not convey the intended meaning of self-praise. (ट्रम्पेट बजाना)

 
 
• **Example:** The musician started blowing the trumpet to signal the beginning of the show.
 
 
 
• **"Blowing his own trumpet"** is a phrase used to describe someone who is praising themselves excessively or boasting about their own achievements. (अपनी प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He loves blowing his own trumpet, always talking about how successful his projects are.
 
 
 
• Hence, "blowing his own trumpet" is the correct idiomatic phrase to describe Professor Revanth's behavior in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (blowing his own trumpet)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Sounding the trumpet** (ट्रम्पेट बजाना): Refers to literally making a sound with a trumpet, but does not express the idea of self-praise.

 
 
• **Example:** The band started sounding the trumpet to announce the arrival of the king.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: The blow of a trumpet** (ट्रम्पेट की आवाज): Refers to the act or sound produced by blowing into a trumpet. It is not appropriate for describing self-praise.
 
 
• **Example:** The blow of a trumpet echoed through the hall during the ceremony.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The sound of the trumpet** (ट्रम्पेट की ध्वनि): Refers to the sound produced by a trumpet, but does not convey the intended meaning of self-praise.
 
 
• **Example:** The sound of the trumpet signaled the start of the parade.
